title: albizia glaberrima var. glabrescens
intro: Albizia glaberrima var. glabrescens, commonly known as the African Albizia or False Sensitive Plant, is a plant species of the Fabaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Albizia glaberrima var. glabrescens include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against cell damage. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiviral activities.
